name: release-rebalance-npcfleets-0.1.0
desc: New mod Rebalance NpcFleets 0.1.0: large Fu ship (300) removed from the NPC purchase list; 7 NPC fleets re-shipped (pirates: 간증선/해창선/개랑선, trade fleets: 복선).
commits: feat(rebalance-npcfleets): no large Fu ship for NPCs (0.1.0)

New mod Restitutor_Rebalance_NpcFleets 0.1.0 (Mods/Rebalance). Two postfixes on table load: TemplateManager.InitGameConst drops 300 from NPC_BUY_SHIP_LIST, TemplateManager.InitNpcShipTeam re-ships the 7 fleets that used a large Fu ship (pirates: 3293 flagship, 3291/3294 escorts; trade fleets: 3290), only when a row still equals the original. New saves; fleets already stored in a save keep their ships.
chore: release script for Rebalance NpcFleets 0.1.0
